shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: The pop-up panel, the only lifted surface.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: State changes and the pop-up entrance.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action on a band: a cobalt pill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1F3FCC; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; height: 48px; padding: 0 28px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, #1F3FCC 88%, #0F1D26); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0F1D26; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The quieter second action: a deep-channel outline pill.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #0F1D26; font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; height: 48px; padding: 0 28px; border: 1px solid #0F1D26; border-radius: 999px; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #E1EAEF; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0F1D26; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hero Heading
components.description: Large display heading with the coral accent words (the Flare Rule). Shows the authored coral; the site uses the solved value.
components.css: .ds-hero { font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw + 0.5rem, 5rem); line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #0F1D26; } .ds-hero-accent { color: #F06A4D; }

components.name: Pop-up Panel
components.description: The only lifted surface: sea mist, 12px corners, the overlay shadow.
components.html: Get the tide table by email.
components.css: .ds-popup { background: #F3F6F8; color: #0F1D26; border-radius: 12px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 20px 56px rgb(15 29 38 / 0.22); font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; }

narrative.overview: A harbour on a clear morning: cool, washed daylight surfaces, deep channel-blue ink, one confident cobalt for anything a visitor can act on, and a flash of signal coral where the page wants to be noticed. Bold and civic rather than soft; clarity is the personality.
keyCharacteristics: Cool daylight grounds, deep channel ink, one cobalt for action.
Archivo headings over Public Sans reading text, with a large display size.
Coral appears on two things only: hero accent words and countdown numerals.

rules.name: The Harbour Signal Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only colour that means "go". Buttons, links and the banner use it; nothing else does.

rules.name: The Flare Rule
rules.body: Coral appears only on the hero accent words and the countdown numerals, always at display size.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Regular for reading, semibold for headings and button labels.

rules.name: The Calm Water Rule
rules.body: Bands, images and buttons sit flat. Only the pop-up panel lifts.

dos: Do keep Sea Mist (#F3F6F8) as the ground for most of every page, with Tide Pool (#E1EAEF) for alternate bands.
Do use Harbour Cobalt (#1F3FCC) for buttons, links and the banner.
Do set headings in Archivo at weight 600 and reading text in Public Sans.
donts: Don't use Signal Coral for body text, links, buttons or backgrounds.
Don't square off the buttons; the pill is part of the signal.
Don't add shadows to bands, images or buttons.
